# IMSA GTD PRO — data quality

Lap accounting for **all 47 race-seasons** of this class, one row each. Not a sample: the per-series version of this report accounted for the races its author had loaded, which for IMSA was 10 of 140.

**102,465 raw laps, 72,481 kept (70.7%)**, median 73.4% per race.

Each lap is dropped by exactly one stage, in this order, so the columns sum to the raw total:

| stage | laps | what it removes |
|---|---|---|
| non-green or pit | 18,604 | neutralised, in-lap, out-lap |
| missing tyre age | 0 | no stint reconstruction possible |
| field-wide trim | 3,157 | a lap the whole field ran slowly — a neutralisation ramp or standing start the flags missed |
| per-car trim | 8,203 | each car's slowest residuals, after the first-pass fit |
| too few car laps | 20 | cars with too little running to carry a fixed effect |
